strings.component.name: Avatar Texture Optimizer
strings.component.description: Analyzes avatar mesh UVs, scales UV islands by target quality, packs them into atlases and remaps meshes, materials and animations to maximize texture utilization.
strings.settings.generateAtlas.tip: When disabled, textures are scaled directly without UV remapping, unused-UV trimming or atlas packing.
strings.quality.targetQuality.tip: 1 = near-lossless: islands are copied without resampling and UV scaling is skipped.
strings.quality.advanced.tip: Concrete thresholds change with the selected tier. Custom tier parameters are user-defined and never overwritten (default all 1 = near-lossless).
strings.atlas.enableNPOT.tip: 64px step sizes up to the platform max. Disables incompatible compressed formats (e.g. PVRTC on iOS).
strings.whitelist.tip: All textures referenced inside whitelisted objects skip all optimization.
strings.warning.whitelistedWrapUV: UV out of bounds and wrapping (repeat sampling): treated as whitelist, skipped.
strings.warning.unpackableIsland: Island too large for any atlas: atlasization skipped, scaled by quality.
strings.error.notOnAvatar: AvatarTextureOptimizer must be attached to an object with a VRCAvatarDescriptor.
strings.error.multipleComponents: Only one AvatarTextureOptimizer is allowed per avatar (root + children).
strings.report.title: --- Avatar Texture Optimizer Report ---
